reasons: The candidate multiplies by 100 twice, and neither constant is in the Datadog source. That scales the result by 10000 relative to the rate of system.disk.io_time, so the numbers are wrong.

system.disk.io_time is cumulative seconds, so rate() gives a busy ratio in 0-1 per device. Datadog system.io.util is a percent. The unit difference should be stated in notes with a proposed scale of 100 and a documentation link, not applied in promql.

The quantity (device busy time) and the avg over all devices match the Datadog request, and the unfiltered $scope variable is correctly dropped. The corrected promql would be avg(rate({otel_metric_name="system.disk.io_time", otel_metric_type="sum"}[$__rate_interval])) with the scale in notes.
